data.one_liner: A Dart package for reading XDG directory configuration information on Linux.
data.what_it_does: Provides a Dart API to determine XDG user directories and base directories on Linux. Allows reading values like dataHome, configHome, cacheHome, runtimeDir, stateHome, and user directories.
use_when: You are developing a Linux-targeted Dart or Flutter application that needs to follow XDG base directory standards
You need to locate user-specific configuration, data, or cache directories on Linux
avoid_when: Your application targets platforms other than Linux where XDG directories are not used
You require cross-platform path resolution without platform-specific checks
strengths: Directly supports XDG specification base and user directories
data.setup_notes: No special setup required beyond adding the dependency.

alternatives.name: path_provider
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you need cross-platform directory resolution (Android, iOS, Linux, macOS, Windows) instead of Linux-specific XDG directories.
